en: Yesterday: two fathers and two sons caught three fish, and each took home one whole fish.
The answer? There were only three people.
A grandfather, his son, and his grandson.
The man in the middle is a father, and a son, at the same time.
Two fathers, two sons. Three people, three fish.
An old clock tower strikes six times, in exactly five seconds.
Person one stands below, and counts every strike.
Each strike is instant, and the gaps between them are always equal.
So how long does it take, to strike twelve times?
Careful. It is not ten seconds.
Comment your answer. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.
